definitions.explanation: Active efforts to find a marriage partner, including attending matchmaking events and using dating services.

examples.japanese: {婚活|こんかつ}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{婚活|こんかつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for a marriage partner.

examples.japanese: {婚活|こんかつ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

notes:
{婚活|こんかつ} refers to active efforts to find a marriage partner. Short for ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧.

WORD FORMATION:
Abbreviated from ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧ (marriage) + ⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ (activities). Coined around 2007, modeled after ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧ (⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧, job hunting).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {婚活|こんかつ}⟦パーティー→パーティー：02946_paatii⟧: matchmaking party
- {婚活|こんかつ}⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧: dating/matchmaking app
- {婚活|こんかつ}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: currently looking for a partner
- {婚活|こんかつ}⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れ：03518_tsukare⟧: marriage-hunting fatigue

RELATED 〜{活|かつ} WORDS:
- ⟦{就活|しゅうかつ}→就活：05832_shuukatsu⟧: job hunting
- ⟦{朝活|あさかつ}→朝活：06450_asakatsu⟧: early-morning activities
- ⟦{終活|しゅうかつ}→終活：27374_shuukatsu⟧: end-of-life preparation
- ⟦{妊活|にんかつ}→妊活：29045_ninkatsu⟧: trying to conceive

CULTURAL NOTE:
As traditional matchmaking (⟦お{見合|みあ}い→見合い：14159_miai⟧) has declined, {婚活|こんかつ} fills the gap with modern methods: dating apps, organized parties, and ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦{相談所|そうだんじょ}→相談所：29058_soudanjo⟧ (marriage agencies).
